## Observed (read-only over SSM, 2026-11-10 ~17:35 PST, host i-00880b2c7f13527c5)

- Live MCP container `rebar-mcp-06b3b1a52303-8093` (image built at 06b3b1a5230, up ~23 h, healthy). Its env sets `REBAR_ROOT=MCP_CODE_DIR=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code`, so the server reads `rebar.toml` from that workspace, not from the image's `/app`.
- Workspace HEAD = `3835269d792` (2026-10-28 13:48 PDT). Its `origin/main` was fetched to `06b3b1a5230`; GitHub main is now `91182f96362`.
- Running `LLMConfig.from_env()` + `resolve_model_string` inside the container resolves: default model `bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8`; `frontier` → opus-4-8, `standard` → sonnet-4-6, `trivial` → haiku-4-5. main's `rebar.toml` (after 3340 / `06b3b1a5230`) names the 5.5 models. **Production plan review is not running on the 5.5 models.**
- `git status --porcelain` shows 27 staged entries. The index equals the tree of `e2ed08b343a` exactly (`git diff --cached --quiet e2ed08b343a` → 0), the working tree equals the index, there are 0 untracked files, and `e2ed08b343a^` = `3835269d792`. Index mtime 2026-10-28 17:47:28 PDT; last reflog entry is the 14:14 PDT fast-forward to `3835269d792`.
- The entrypoint's `refresh_code_locked` refuses a dirty tree, so every restart since logs `mcp: dirty code checkout — refusing refresh` (first journal hit 2026-10-29 17:16 PDT). The refusal is stderr-only; nothing alerted.

## Hypotheses (unproven)

The state matches a fast-forward to `e2ed08b343a` that wrote index and working tree but never moved HEAD (process killed between the two). The killer is unidentified: the rebar-mcp journal has no entries in that window; autodeploy ran its 2-minute MCP reconcile throughout.

## Impact

Every production gate that resolves config through this workspace uses the pre-3340 config: 4.x models, and any config key added after 2026-10-28. The 5.5 upgrade (and the Opus 5.5 refusal fix verification) is not live.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] [non-codebase] The production workspace is repaired by an operator-approved write and reports `0 0` against origin/main (runbook review-bot-ops.md "MCP code workspace freshness"); a fresh in-container resolution shows frontier/standard/trivial on the 5.5 ids.
  provenance: environment=production rebar host i-00880b2c7f13527c5 (MCP container); principal=frontier operator role via SSM; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — repair by SSM command 86220c94 then read-only in-container git rev-list and LLMConfig resolution, recorded in ticket comments
- [x] The interrupted-fast-forward state (clean against a descendant commit of HEAD that is an ancestor of origin/main) is either recovered safely by the entrypoint or surfaced loudly (alarm/health), with a test reproducing the stuck state.
- [x] Root cause of the interruption identified or the evidence searched recorded.

No config key, env var or flag in the fix.
